capabilities: Embed vault HTML files, URLs, or inline HTML via one auto-detecting ```artifact code block
Sandbox embedded HTML in an iframe with no same-origin access to the vault
Inject Obsidian CSS theme variables into embedded HTML for light/dark mode support
Provide a card toolbar to reload, open externally, and copy the source
Support per-block height and title directives on the first line
extras: Not yet in the community plugin browser; must be installed manually from release files or a cloned repo. No settings tab in v0.1 (default height and sandbox flags are hard-coded).
motivation: The author wanted polished, sandboxed, theme-aware interactive widgets (cheatsheets, charts, mini-tools) embedded inline next to prose, which none of the existing workarounds provide.
problem: Plain Obsidian can't run interactive HTML inline safely: pasting raw HTML pollutes global CSS, HTML viewers open in separate tabs, and URL iframes only work in sidebar panes.
summary: Renders local HTML files, remote URLs, or inline HTML as sandboxed, theme-aware artifact cards in notes via a single ```artifact code block.
